device.category: analogue microtonal drone synthesizer with touch keyboard, 8 voices, dual Polivoks filter and cartridge effects; desktop, no MIDI
device.based_on: Successor to the Elta SOLAR 50 (2021); designed by Arseny Tokarev, made in Riga, Latvia; launched 2023. Followed by the SOLAR 42F and 42N (renumbered voices, added distortion and sub-oscillators).

architecture.polyphony_mode: eight independent voices: six drones on push-buttons or gates, two VCO voices on the touch keyboard (single or split)
architecture.patch_memory_note: No sound presets; the touch keyboard stores its own settings and sequencer presets.
architecture.summary: Four 'classic' drone voices (1, 2, 6, 7), each five independently tuned sawtooth generators (no V/oct) spanning about B0-D7, with a VOLT knob that detunes them down together and then cross-modulates them, and a photosensor driven by a red LED for pitch modulation. Two 'Papa Srapa' voices (3, 8): an audio square cross-modulated (FM/AM) by a low-frequency square, blended with white noise, with sample and hold. Two AS3340 VCO voices (4, 5) with six waveforms including two morphing shapes, voice 4 normalled into voice 5's FM. Every voice has an envelope (AR on the drones) with CV in and out and HOLD. A 10-channel stereo mixer (8 voices, external audio, preamp) feeds a dual 12 dB Polivoks filter and a dual cartridge effector with X/Y/Z CV. Two LFOs, a 5-step sequencer with pulser, a joystick and a contact-mic envelope follower provide CV.

modules.name: Touch keyboard and drone buttons
modules.description: 12 capacitive plates with V/oct, gate and pressure outputs (single or split), arpeggiator, sequencer, quantiser, portamento, vibrato and presets; six push-buttons gate the drone voices.

modules.name: Voice 1 (classic drone)
modules.description: Five sawtooth generators, each with its own TUNE knob and on/off key: 1st C0-G2, 2nd B1-G3, 3rd D3-B4, 4th E4-C6, 5th G5-D7. VOLT transposes all five down together, then makes them frequency-modulate each other. A photosensor lit by a red LED (from LFO or CV) bends the pitch. Envelope (attack/release, HOLD) into the voice VCA.

VOLT transposes all five down together, then makes them frequency-modulate each other. A photosensor lit by a red LED (from LFO or CV) bends the pitch. Envelope (attack/release, HOLD) into the voice VCA.

VOLT transposes all five down together, then makes them frequency-modulate each other. A photosensor lit by a red LED (from LFO or CV) bends the pitch. modules.name: Voice 7 (classic drone)
modules.description: Five sawtooth generators, each with its own TUNE knob and on/off key: 1st C0-G2, 2nd B1-G3, 3rd D3-B4, 4th E4-C6, 5th G5-D7. VOLT transposes all five down together, then makes them frequency-modulate each other. A photosensor lit by a red LED (from LFO or CV) bends the pitch. Envelope (attack/release, HOLD) into the voice VCA.

modules.name: Voice 3 (Papa Srapa drone)
modules.description: After Papa Srapa's DIY noise synths: two Schmitt-trigger square oscillators. The low-frequency one is a modulator (RATE knob, x1/x10 switch, CV OUT); the other is the tone, C0-E7 (PITCH). FM AMOUNT and DIVIDER set the modulation depth; FM and AM toggles choose frequency modulation, interruption (AM) or both. White noise and a sample and hold sit alongside; attack/release envelope with HOLD, gated by its push-button. Sirens, birds, gunfire, surf, wind.

modules.name: Voice 8 (Papa Srapa drone)
modules.description: After Papa Srapa's DIY noise synths: two Schmitt-trigger square oscillators. The low-frequency one is a modulator (RATE knob, x1/x10 switch, CV OUT); the other is the tone, C0-E7 (PITCH). FM AMOUNT and DIVIDER set the modulation depth; FM and AM toggles choose frequency modulation, interruption (AM) or both. White noise and a sample and hold sit alongside; attack/release envelope with HOLD, gated by its push-button. Sirens, birds, gunfire, surf, wind.

modules.name: Voice 4 (VCO)
modules.description: AS3340 triangle-core VCO: six waveforms (including saw-to-inverted-saw and sine-to-triangle morphs with SHAPE), octave switch and tune, 1 V/oct input, envelope (ADSR/ASR/AD/looped AD per manual excerpts) into its VCA. Has a VCO output.

modules.name: Voice 5 (VCO)
modules.description: AS3340 triangle-core VCO: six waveforms (including saw-to-inverted-saw and sine-to-triangle morphs with SHAPE), octave switch and tune, 1 V/oct input, envelope (ADSR/ASR/AD/looped AD per manual excerpts) into its VCA. Has a SYNC input; voice 4's VCO output is normalled to its FM input.

modules.name: LFO A and B
modules.description: Two LFOs, A slow and B fast, each blending square and triangle (centre = mix); positive-only output so they can drive the drone photosensors' red LEDs.

modules.name: Sequencer and pulser
modules.description: Buchla-inspired 5-stage sequential voltage source: per-step 0-5 V level and gate, 3/4/5 stages, internal PULSER clock or external clock.

modules.name: Joystick
modules.description: Two-axis CV with an offset per axis selecting -10..0 V (left), -5..+5 V (middle) or 0..+10 V (right).

modules.name: Contact mic, preamp and envelope follower
modules.description: Built-in piezo under the keyboard (the case becomes a microphone) or an external source; preamp gain; envelope follower (attack, release) with envelope and gate outputs; audio to the mixer.

modules.name: Mixer
modules.description: Volume and pan for voices 1-8, external audio and preamp: ten channels to a stereo bus.

modules.name: Dual Polivoks filter
modules.description: Two 12 dB/oct lo-fi filters on the classic Soviet Polivoks chip (left and right), frequency and resonance each, CV on frequency, LINK.

modules.name: Dual cartridge effector
modules.description: Two cartridge effect circuits (left and right, as in the Elta Console pedal and SOLAR 50); BLEND sets the effect level; X, Y, Z parameters under CV (-10..+10 V).

modules.name: Outputs
modules.description: Wet L/R (MASTER VOLUME), dry outputs for the keyboard voices, headphones.

behaviours.name: Classic drone voices
behaviours.rule: Five sawtooth generators per voice (no V/oct), tuned by ear into chords, triads or clusters across about B0-D7 and switched in or out individually. VOLT lowers all five at different rates, so the chord drifts as it falls, then turns into cross-FM. Photosensors (red LEDs, positive voltage only) give pitch modulation from the LFOs or any positive CV.

behaviours.name: Papa Srapa voices
behaviours.rule: Two Schmitt-trigger squares: a low-frequency modulator (RATE, x1/x10, CV OUT 0 to +12 V) and a tone oscillator (PITCH, about C0-E7). FM AMOUNT and DIVIDER set the depth. FM up gives frequency modulation; FM down with AM up chops the tone at RATE; both up combine them. Noise and sample and hold alongside. Sirens, bird calls, space monsters, gunfire, surf and wind.

behaviours.name: VCO voices
behaviours.rule: AS3340 oscillators with six waveforms (two morphing with SHAPE), 1 V/oct, FM and sync; voice 4's oscillator is normalled into voice 5's FM. Played from the touch keyboard (single or split) or external CV.

behaviours.name: Envelopes
behaviours.rule: Each voice opens its VCA from an envelope triggered by its button, the keyboard or an external 5 V gate; HOLD keeps it open. Envelope outputs can trigger the next voice or modulate the filter and effector.

behaviours.name: Touch keyboard
behaviours.rule: 12 capacitive plates with V/oct, gate and pressure outputs; single or split behaviour; keyboard, arpeggiator or sequencer (2-16 steps) modes; quantiser on (notes) or off (microtonal); portamento; vibrato (speed, depth, delay); internal clock 10-300 BPM or external; presets; calibration by holding the encoder at power-up.

behaviours.name: Signal path
behaviours.rule: Eight voices, external audio and the preamp are mixed and panned to stereo, filtered by two Polivoks 12 dB filters (left and right) and processed by two cartridge effect circuits; BLEND and MASTER VOLUME set the wet outputs. The two circuits differ slightly, giving a live stereo image.

behaviours.name: Modulation sources
behaviours.rule: Elta lists 'two LFOs and three square pulse generators' (the 'five LFO generators' of the manual): LFO A (slow) and B (fast), square-to-triangle, 0 to +10 V; plus the PULSER and the two Papa Srapa modulators, each with an output. 5-step sequencer (0-5 V steps, gates, pulser or external clock); joystick (-10..0, -5..+5 or 0..+10 V per axis); contact mic or external source to an envelope follower (0-10 V) and gate (0-8 V).

midi.note: No MIDI: control is by the panel, touch keyboard and CV/gate.

specifications.drone_voices: 4 classic (5 saw generators each) + 2 Papa Srapa
specifications.modulation_generators: 2 LFOs + 3 square pulse generators (pulser, two Papa Srapa modulators)

not_in_source: full jack list and exact panel positions (manual PDF not readable here)
source_inconsistencies: Elta's specification says 'VOICE 3, 5 modulator out 0...+12V'. The manual places the modulator CV OUT on the Papa Srapa voices, 3 and 8 in this numbering (3 and 6 on the 42F/42N); voice 5 is a VCO. The same specification block, still listing 'ENV OUT VOICES 1,2,3,6,7,8', is reused unchanged on Elta's 42F/42N page, so the '3, 5' error is in Elta's published text, not a transcription slip. Modelled on voices 3 and 8.
The mixer page calls the instrument 'SOLAR 52' (a typo; no SOLAR 52 exists).
The manual's 'five LFO generators' are, per Elta's own feature list, two LFOs plus three square pulse generators: the pulser and the two Papa Srapa modulators (resolved).

Later 42F/42N material renumbers the voices (classic drones 1, 2, 4, 5; Papa Srapa 3, 6; VCO A/B), and owners report the 42F manual mixes old and new names, which can be confused with this original layout.

modelling_gaps.detail: Elta's manual PDF was too large to fetch and the panel PDF has no text; the model uses indexed manual excerpts, the supplied specs and secondary sources. Uploading the PDFs would allow a full check.
Jacks are those named in the sources; the full panel likely has more (per-voice VOLT/photo/shape CV), marked inferred where assumed.
Control detail taken from the 42F-based VCV recreation is marked inferred.
